survey.title: 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Comprehensive Survey

criteria: Core: detects 3D objects (3D bounding boxes) from LiDAR or other point clouds, alone or fused with camera images.

Detectors, backbones and representations (point, voxel, pillar, range view, BEV), training schemes (semi-/self-supervised, domain adaptation, augmentation) and datasets or benchmarks for this task count, in driving or indoor scenes.

Out of scope: camera-only 3D detection (monocular, stereo, multi-view) with no point cloud input; 2D detection; point cloud classification or segmentation without detection; tracking or motion forecasting that takes detections as given; generic architectures never applied to 3D detection.
